clips.title: The story
paras: Stone statues watch over the Valley of Heroes, where Stormwind's southern road crosses the moat into the city. They honor the leaders of the Alliance Expedition to Draenor, and guards hold this fortified entrance.

You cross the moat beneath statues honoring the commanders of the Alliance Expedition. Stormwind's rebuilding after the Second War raised these monuments along the causeway. The champions marched through the Dark Portal into Draenor to seal the rift forever, giving their lives so Azeroth might survive. As you head north toward the Trade District, you pass Archmage Khadgar, Kurdran Wildhammer, Ranger-Captain Alleria Windrunner, Force Commander Danath Trollbane, and High General Turalyon.

General Marcus Jonathan watches Stormwind's gates from horseback, overseeing the guards and the traffic in and out. The valley is the city's main defense against an overland invasion. Major Mattingly, Field Marshal Stonebridge, and rows of seasoned guards keep watch beside him, guarding the capital from threats beyond its walls.
